title: Problem with thunderbird android
creator: davor3
content:
Hello.

I'm wondering if anyone else has similar problems with Thunderbird on Android... Namely, sometimes when I delete messages, the app just stutters or freezes. Today I even deleted some spam messages, and when I refresh, they come back as if I did nothing. The app worked fine for months, but lately I've been having problems. The only solution right now is to delete them on the desktop. But what is the point of the app then? I've cleared the cache, even reinstalled, but these problems keep coming back...
